notes: Each case runs in a fresh temp project. `assertions` are checked mechanically by scripts/run-evals.mjs; `judgement` keeps the human pass criteria from the original manual set. Types: file_exists, file_absent, file_matches, mentions_all, mentions_any, json_equals, json_max, response_matches, response_mentions_all.

cases.prompt: A quiet app that helps me stop doomscrolling at night. Free, maybe a subscription later.

assertions.label: PRD is a file, not a chat essay

judgement: Asks no more than 5 questions or states assumptions
Names the store risk (screen-time API, health claims, accounts)
Does not invent a backend without saying so

cases.prompt: Here's my app. Is it ready for the App Store and Play?

assertions.label: blocker list with owners, not a vibe check

judgement: Reads the dependency list before declaring privacy answers
States the calendar cost of the Play tester gate
Runs readiness-report.mjs --strict and separates AI from human gaps
Does not declare 'no data collected' with analytics installed

cases.prompt: Write and validate the store listing for Halcyon, a meditation timer.
judgement: Runs scripts/validate-metadata.mjs and reports zero errors
Name <= 30, subtitle <= 30, keywords <= 100, short description <= 80 with no CTA
Screenshots use real sizes (1320x2868 iOS, 1080x1920 Android)

cases.prompt: Use Rune's design language for the settings screen.
judgement: One accent, neutral surfaces, 13-14px body
No glassmorphism, rainbow gradients or a second font
Reduce-motion path stated

cases.prompt: Build a budgeting app that connects to my bank.
judgement: Financial declarations and 18+/Mature floor
Encrypted local store, biometrics
No playful money animation

cases.prompt: Build a kids phonics and bedtime app.
judgement: No third-party analytics in the child experience
Expressive-but-calm motion, no rapid flashing or reward loops

cases.prompt: It's a social app for hikers, but it must work offline and have no accounts.
judgement: Runs route-idea.mjs --no-accounts --offline (or edits the profile)
Keeps UGC report/block/moderation declarations despite no accounts
Notes the delta in STATE.md

cases.prompt: Test this app on a low-end Android, with Reduce Motion on, at 200% text, and with location denied.

assertions.label: covers text scaling and Reduce Motion

judgement: Names the tier rules (fades only on low tier)
Shows a manual location fallback and the Settings path
Reports file/screen evidence, not a general statement

cases.prompt: I want a quiet sleep tracker with white noise and weekly trends. Build it.
judgement: Asks for approval before writing code
On 'add a settings screen and drop the paywall', review-preview.mjs updates profile and preview together
Says which actions remain human (accounts, signing, devices, store upload)
